title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(伊東健治研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Ito Kenji)
educationalGoal: This course is the final destination of design project course. Regarding to the project theme, theoretical, experimental investigations are done for integration of knowledge. Project theme: Microwave semiconductor circuits Activities: Through research activities for each student, a PDCA cycle for research is introduced.
advice: Following PDCA cycle is arranged: i) Assignment of the project theme: Detailed technical theme is established from technical area of microwave semiconductor circuits. ii) Understanding of the background of the assigned project theme: Through investigations for past works, technical issues that will be solved through the activity is clarified. iii) Planning research activities: The planned schedule is reviewed in weekly meetings. Final destination that is “differentiation compared with past works” is defined through discussions. iv) Learnings of EDA tools: Microwave circuit simulator (Keysite ADS), Analog IC design simulator (Cadence Virtuoso), EM simulator (Keysite EM-pro) are trained. v) First design activity: Design procedures is established at first. By using theoretical and simulational approaches, first circuit is designed. vi) First validation activity: With use of PCB etching, the validated circuit is fabricated. vii) Analysis of the first trial: From difference between the design and the validation results, improvement actions are planned. Above activities are reviewed in weekly meetings. Deliverables of the project are implemented as “the project report”. And they are presented in the review conference in Feb.
requiredKnowledge: i) Acquisition of electrical circuits, electronic circuits and EM theory. Enough skill of mathematics (basic functions, integral calculus, complex number) ii) Basic presentation skills and technical writing skill.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand basis of microwave circuit.
Be able to plan and explain about objectives and outline of the research activities.
Be able to report the activity in a week.
Be able to explain the research activity
Be able to describe the research deliverable as the project report, and to present it in the review conference.
